Made by dreamers

Pieces Collective started with a simple idea: we don't wear clothes, we wear pieces. Each design is a small piece of who we are, and together they make the bigger picture.

Based in the Philippines and creating an international movement, we make oversized tees, drop shoulder tank tops and mesh shorts with graphics that say something.

01

Not all damage is visible

Hidden Struggles is for the pieces of ourselves we keep hidden. Your struggles are proof that you kept going.

The collective

Pieces is more than a label. It's the crew, the friends and family, and everyone who wears a piece and makes it their own.
